question: Which remaining community-skill ecosystem contracts should OpenClaw own in this repository versus ClawHub/service/plugins, and should this umbrella remain canonical after diagnostics, watcher, and install-trust pieces landed?
rationale: The remaining work defines public skill metadata, trust/security semantics, publishing-service behavior, runtime permission boundaries, and possible agent-pack packaging; automation cannot safely choose those ownership and compatibility boundaries.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Scope
options.body: Keep this issue open as the consolidation tracker while maintainers create or bless narrow trackers for permission/provenance, trigger metadata, publishing-service issues, lifecycle hooks, and agent-pack packaging.

options.title: Promote Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move the remaining bullets to existing narrow issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10827, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/18677, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54799, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782, then close the umbrella once the transfer is explicit.

options.title: Route Most Work To ClawHub
options.body: Close the OpenClaw umbrella only after deciding that remaining publish, trust, and package-discovery behavior belongs outside this repository and filing any missing OpenClaw API/security gaps separately.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Scope
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the consolidation tracker while maintainers create or bless narrow trackers for permission/provenance, trigger metadata, publishing-service issues, lifecycle hooks, and agent-pack packaging.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily product/security boundary ownership across core skills, plugins, and ClawHub, and steipete has the strongest current VISION and skill lifecycle routing signal in the inspected history.
